## Outcome

Describe the observable result and why it belongs in RakamLah's portable core or examples.

## Verification

- [ ] I watched each new behavioral test fail before implementing the change.
- [ ] `corepack pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `corepack pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] I inspected affected capture, audio, subtitle, or video artifacts directly when applicable.
- [ ] I updated configuration or agent documentation when its contract changed.
- [ ] I added no credentials, machine paths, generated recordings, model caches, or worker artifacts.
- [ ] Added media has explicit use, synthesis, and redistribution authorization and passes the manifest check.

## Evidence

List commands, metadata, screenshots, or focused observations used to verify the outcome. Redact sensitive material.

## Compatibility

Describe any command, JSON, exit-code, config, adapter, media, or platform impact. Write “none” when unchanged.
